title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Offer Summary
text: Activate your Corporate Salary Account and get exciting rewards worth up to Rs. 2000.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Offer Communication Requirement
text: The offer is only applicable to the customers who have received the offer communication from HDFC bank via email or other official communication channels.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Salary Credit Timing
text: Customer will become eligible only after salary gets credited in the same month of the communication being received or before next month's end in which the campaign has been executed. (e.g. Communication received in Mar'25, Salary to be credited before 30th Apr'25).

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Minimum Salary Requirement
text: Minimum Salary credited should be Rs 7,500 and above to be eligible for the offer.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Voucher Delivery Timeline
text: The eligible customers will receive the voucher via email within 60 days of Salary credit.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - New Account Requirement
text: This offer is valid only for New Corporate Salary Accounts opened in the current financial year.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Email/SMS with Activation Code
text: The eligible customers would be sent an Email/SMS from HDFC Bank along with activation code and URL to avail the benefits.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Visit URL and Enter Details
text: Customer to visit the URL (https://sandbox-hdfc-savings.poshvine.com/), enter the activation code, followed by registered mobile number with the bank and OTP triggered to the customer.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - View Applicable Offers
text: Customer will be shown all the offers applicable as per the program.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Claim Benefit and Receive Voucher Code
text: Customer can claim the benefit(s). On claiming, the voucher code will be displayed on the platform/website and sent to customer via SMS.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Visit Partner/Brand
text: Customer has to visit respective partner / brand to claim the generated voucher.

title: Corporate Salary Account Activation Offer - Activation Code Validity
text: The activation code is valid for 90 days from the date of receipt of communication.
